case.component: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM: INTEGRATED TRAILER BRAKE CONTROL
case.narrative: This brake controller seems to apply full brakes regardless of the settings within the app. I have reinstalled it several times as directed by the manufacturere and each time I get on the road and just barely touch the brakes it locks the trailer brakes. This is dangerous since there is no way to test the system without driving.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
